label: sec:derivation-audit-preamble
html: Arc III concludes by synthesizing the complete pre-archimedean derivation chain from the braided monoidal axioms over \mathbb{Q}(q) to the symbolic mass and binding functionals prior to numerical evaluation at q_0. This section tabulates the exact dependency chain of theorems, conditional hypotheses, and open conjectures (such as the SDP canonical knot identification and the structural \rho-prefactor law), and proves the refutation of the naive Frobenius co-Casimir ansatz on the deuteron channel.
